decisions.reason: It remained on the home page through 2024, suggesting results are at least close enough to aspiration levels to justify keeping this low-cost, exploratory program under available organisational slack despite its indirect fit with core machinery revenues.

Its dedicated page in both 2023 and 2024 indicates continued commitment, but as a less obviously core offering for a machinery firm and with no stronger prominence signal, management would keep it while monitoring whether performance rises above aspiration.

The product stayed prominently on the home page with a sharpened 2024 value proposition, which for a machinery producer points to performance meeting or exceeding aspiration enough to retain it as a core new-business line.
